issue.title: docs-check lychee: docs/gcal-notes.md links ../reference/mac-capture/event-notes.md, which climbs out of docs/
issue.description:
## What fails

Repo: bob-cli. `just docs-check` (offline lychee link gate via `uv run --project tools/docs bob-docs links`) reports one broken link on master 70f69c23:

```
[target/docs/site/gcal-notes/index.html]:
[ERROR] file:///.../target/docs/reference/mac-capture/event-notes | File not found
```

## Root cause (confirmed)

`docs/gcal-notes.md:17` (added in 23e7f90d, bead bob-cli-ji.7.1.6, epic closed) links
`[Event notes](../reference/mac-capture/event-notes.md)`. `gcal-notes.md` sits at the
docs root, so `../` climbs out of `docs/`. The mounted page exists at
`docs/reference/mac-capture/event-notes.md`; the link should be
`reference/mac-capture/event-notes.md`.

## Fix

Change the one relative path, then run `uv run --project tools/docs bob-docs build`
and `uv run --project tools/docs bob-docs links` (or `just docs-check`) to confirm zero
lychee errors.

## Provenance

Proposed by bob-cli-ky.6 (note #2) and bob-cli-ky.7 (note #1) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP;
reproduced by the bob-cli-ky land agent on 2026-11-12.
